allowlist.title: Allowlisted sites
allowlist.description: Hostnames where ClickFix Guard is switched off entirely, ADDED to the built-in list (AI assistants, translation tools, dev docs...). Each entry also covers its subdomains (github.com covers gist.github.com). Entries inside neverAllowlist have no effect.

neverAllowlist.title: Sites users can never trust
neverAllowlist.description: Hosts that are always scanned, ADDED to the built-in list (pages.dev, sites.google.com, ...). Wins over every allowlist, and the banner's 'Trust this site' button is hidden there.

removeFromBuiltin.title: Remove built-in entries
removeFromBuiltin.description: Exact hostnames to take out of the built-in allowlist or neverAllowlist. Use sparingly: removing a neverAllowlist entry lets that multi-tenant host be allowlisted and trusted.

threshold.title: Warning threshold
threshold.description: Score at which the warning banner is shown. Default 5.

allowUserTrust.title: Let users trust a site from the banner
allowUserTrust.description: Pilot switch. false hides the 'Trust this site' button and ignores every site users trusted earlier. Default true.

webhookUrl.title: Detection webhook
webhookUrl.description: Optional HTTPS endpoint that receives a POST for every detection. A Slack incoming webhook (https://hooks.slack.com/services/...) gets a formatted message with the page URL defanged; any other URL gets the raw JSON (page URL, score, indicators, time).

includeUserEmail.title: Include the user's email in webhook messages
includeUserEmail.description: Adds the email of the account signed in to Chrome to each webhook message. Personal data, sent next to the page URL - review before enabling. Default false.
